timeline.title: Messaging termination race closed
timeline.detail: New messages and attachments now revalidate the CareRelationship immediately, so termination/revocation blocks new care-thread mutations before reconciliation closes the thread.

timeline.title: Care Plan review exactly-once completion
timeline.detail: Review completion now uses compare-and-set persistence; concurrent retries converge on one completed record and only the winning finalizer emits care.plan_review_completed.

timeline.title: Care Plan review durability hardened
timeline.detail: Review execution now atomically claims reviewer/outcome intent, preallocates MODIFY version IDs, resumes safely after partial failure, prevents outcome switching, and writes completion through the transactional outbox.

timeline.title: Care Plan sub-domain authorization hardened
timeline.detail: Care Goal and Care Intervention creation now revalidate the current Care Plan version and care-relationship scope; user-created goals are limited to the subject with USER_SELECTED provenance.

timeline.title: Sprint 22 transactional outbox expanded
timeline.detail: Goal reviews and content/assessment assignments now use UnitOfWork-backed PostgreSQL persistence with canonical outbox events instead of save-then-publish behavior.

timeline.title: Sprint 22 operational maintenance

timeline.title: Task authorization hardened
